name: create type ramp_booking_operation
up_script:
CREATE TABLE ramp_bookings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    ramp_id UUID NOT NULL references ramps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    start_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    stop_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    order_id UUID,
    operation ramp_booking_operation NOT NULL,
    status ramp_booking_status NOT NULL
);
